name: tia_connect_to_io_system
description: Assign an IO device (e.g. a drive's PROFINET adapter) to an IO system (IoConnector.ConnectToIoSystem). Connect its interface to the same subnet first.

interface_path.description: Device-item path of the network interface; omit when the device has only one Ethernet interface.

io_system_name.description: Exact IO system name from tia_list_network.
